snippet.title: Knightmare - Official Game Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A new point-and click adventure game based on the classic TV series. Coming 2027

www.knightmaregame.co.uk

Enter stranger! Lord Fear has returned and a new quest awaits. Only the bravest of Dungeoneers can don the famous Helmet of Justice and venture into this dangerous world of illusion. It is time to step boldly forward as the time of Knightmare begins again!

Featuring:
- Fully voiced by the original stars of Knightmare
- Hand-drawn artwork and animation
- Deadly puzzles
- A simple point-and-click gameplay system

Starring:
Hugo Myatt, Mark Knight, Clifford Barry, Katharine Bennett-Fox, Edmund Dehn, Iona Kennedy, Paul Valentine and Alec Westwood.

Knightmare created by Tim Child
Game written and developed by Ewen Watson
Artwork and illustrations by Sathya Schlösser 
Knightmare logo designed by David Rowe
Knightmare Theme composed by Ed Welch
